scope: CPU-only existing training small metadata/curves and streaming rear loss logs; no tensor payload, cache, raw capture or evaluation outcome read; no science/runtime mutations.
authority: Actual exposure/checkpoint fields copied from root presealed_guard_main_recovery10 actual eight-payload extraction; this audit does not reopen those tensors. Root retains final postclosure payload audit.
deployment: All eight registered components fixed epoch60; no checkpoint reselection.

curve_definitions.late_window: epoch41-60; early5mean41-45 versus late5mean56-60; also endpoints50to60 and descriptive OLS slope.
curve_definitions.normalized_equal_mse: 0.5*mean(normalized arm squared error)+0.5*mean(normalized hand squared error); pooled by recorded legal samples.
curve_definitions.validation: Fixed6 held-out training-validation families,1843 legal control slots per epoch; same families reused every epoch. This is offline teacher-forced validation, not new autonomous held-out evaluation.
curve_definitions.train_evaluation: Fixed first2 training episodes /649 legal control slots per epoch; never a full-pool training metric.
curve_definitions.train_updates: Recorded errors from actual successful optimizer updates with repeated windows/sampling. DP uses noisy sample-prediction; rear uses pre-update composed final-command error. These are not the same as epoch-final fixed-panel evaluation.
curve_definitions.phase: Offline held_near_goal60 uses60mm screen; not native15mm entry, cumulative10tick confirmation, or insertion.
curve_definitions.comparison: Within each role/component only. A DP q_reached and B DP u_expert losses do not rank A/B. Both rear targets u_expert, but their fixed nominal input generators and training pools differ.

limitations: Recorded diagnostic phase is descriptive; held-near60mm is not the15mm gate or native success.
DP training uses sample-prediction diffusion errors over H24 supervised windows; repeated windows count repeatedly.
DP validation uses existing DDIM16 native commit12 predictions. These differ from training noise errors.
Rear training uses actual composed final-command errors before its successful optimizer step; validation uses epoch-final weights.
Squared errors are diagnostics; geometry/FY/regularization components are not decomposed by phase.
A and B DP target spaces differ; these nominal error curves do not rank groups.
Train-evaluation is the trainer existing fixed first2 episodes, not the whole training pool.

A_DP.objective_definition: Per-epoch mean actual optimizer-batch full DP training loss, including registered geometric terms; not the phase nominal error.

limitations: Exposure means at least60 distinct successful optimizer steps for each legal label and DP entry slot under the existing guard; duplicated windows/padding/ancestor updates do not fill that floor.
Training improvement, validation improvement, and autonomous generalization are separate claims. Declining repeated-data errors alone do not prove convergence or independent complete insertion.
Late-window and family directions are descriptive; no confidence intervals or significance tests, and individual ticks are not independent trials.
All perphase errors omit a causal decomposition of geometry/FY/projection contributions.
DP correction_evaluation has only endpoint diagnostics0and60; it cannot establish continuous improvement through the final20epochs.
Reported component wall_seconds may span different resume/wait scopes and are not total session time or GPU compute hours; do not sum them as experiment walltime.
